Title: Doctor successfully raises a new activity request with valid data
Steps: Log in as a user with Doctor role; Navigate to the 'Raise Activity Request' page; Enter a valid activity title in the Title field; Select a valid activity type from the dropdown; Enter a description of at least 20 characters; Set a future date in the Requested Date field; Click the 'Submit' button
Test Data: Title: "Physical Therapy Session", Type: "Therapy", Description: "Patient requires 30‑minute physical therapy", Date: "2024-05-15"
Expected Result: The system displays a success message "Request submitted successfully" and the new request appears in the doctor's pending requests list.

Title: Attempt to raise a request with missing required fields
Steps: Log in as a Doctor; Navigate to the 'Raise Activity Request' page; Leave the Title field empty; Select an activity type; Enter a description; Click the 'Submit' button
Expected Result: The system prevents submission and shows a validation error next to the Title field stating "Title is required".

Title: Attempt to raise a request with an invalid past date
Steps: Log in as a Doctor; Navigate to the 'Raise Activity Request' page; Enter a valid Title and Type; Enter a description; Set the Requested Date to a past date (e.g., yesterday); Click the 'Submit' button
Expected Result: The system displays a validation error "Requested date must be in the future" and does not submit the request.

Title: Doctor attempts to raise a duplicate request for the same activity on the same date
Steps: Log in as a Doctor; Navigate to the 'Raise Activity Request' page; Enter a Title that matches an existing pending request; Select the same activity type; Enter a description; Set the Requested Date to the same date as the existing request; Click the 'Submit' button
Expected Result: The system shows an error message "A request for this activity on the selected date already exists" and prevents duplicate submission.

Title: User without Doctor role attempts to access Raise Activity Request page
Steps: Log in as a user with role 'Nurse'; Attempt to navigate directly to the URL of the 'Raise Activity Request' page
Expected Result: The system redirects to an 'Access Denied' page or shows a message "You do not have permission to perform this action".

Title: Session timeout during request creation
Steps: Log in as a Doctor; Navigate to the 'Raise Activity Request' page; Enter valid data in all fields; Wait for the session to expire (e.g., 15 minutes of inactivity); Click the 'Submit' button
Expected Result: The system redirects to the login page with a message "Your session has expired, please log in again" and does not submit the request.

Title: Maximum length validation for Title field
Steps: Log in as a Doctor; Navigate to the 'Raise Activity Request' page; Enter a Title consisting of 256 characters (exceeding the 200‑character limit); Fill all other required fields with valid data; Click the 'Submit' button
Expected Result: The system displays a validation error "Title cannot exceed 200 characters" and prevents submission.

Title: Special characters handling in Description field
Steps: Log in as a Doctor; Navigate to the 'Raise Activity Request' page; Enter a valid Title and Type; Enter a description containing special characters like "!@#$%^&*()_+|~=`{}[]:";'<>,.?/"; Set a valid future date; Click the 'Submit' button
Expected Result: The request is submitted successfully and the description is stored and displayed exactly as entered without truncation or error.

Title: Performance: Request submission response time
Steps: Log in as a Doctor; Navigate to the 'Raise Activity Request' page; Enter valid data in all fields; Click the 'Submit' button
Expected Result: The system returns a success response and displays the confirmation message within 2 seconds.

Title: Accessibility: Keyboard navigation through the request form
Steps: Log in as a Doctor; Navigate to the 'Raise Activity Request' page using only the keyboard (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter); Move focus to each input field and verify focus order; Submit the form using the Enter key
Expected Result: All form fields are reachable via keyboard in a logical order, and the form can be submitted using the Enter key without mouse interaction.

Title: Upload attachment exceeding size limit
Steps: Log in as a Doctor; Navigate to the 'Raise Activity Request' page; Fill all required fields with valid data; Attempt to attach a file larger than the allowed 5 MB limit; Click the 'Submit' button
Expected Result: The system displays an error message "Attachment exceeds the maximum allowed size of 5 MB" and prevents submission.

Title: Concurrent submissions handling
Steps: Log in as Doctor A on Browser 1; Log in as Doctor A on Browser 2 (same account); In Browser 1, fill a valid request and submit; Immediately in Browser 2, fill a different valid request and submit
Expected Result: Both requests are processed independently; each receives its own success confirmation without data loss or duplication errors.
